title: tc-setup-guide
description: An onboarding panel: a progress bar and collapsible groups of tasks that unlock one after another.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

groups.description: The task groups. Each task's `done` flag is where it starts; when the flags change, the guide follows them

done.description: Ids of the finished tasks; unset follows the tasks' flags. Changed by a tick unless tc-done-change is prevented

openGroup.description: Id of the unfolded group, null for none; unset unfolds the first unfinished group

minimized.description: The body is collapsed to the header

editable.description: Shows an "Edit" link in the header (fires tc-edit)

closable.description: Shows a close button in the header (fires tc-close)
